title: Choosing a Sport
setting: A sunny park with green grass, a hill and a lake.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Max
characters.look: Max, a young boy with blonde hair and a red jacket

sentences.en: Kofi, Hana and Max want to choose a sport.
sentences.zh: 科菲、哈娜和马克斯想选一项运动。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt, Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Max, a young boy with blonde hair and a red jacket stand together in a sunny park, thinking.

sentences.en: Kofi is a fast football player.
sentences.zh: 科菲是个跑得很快的足球运动员。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt runs fast and kicks a football on the grass.

sentences.en: Hana throws a ball for a basketball game.
sentences.zh: 哈娜为一场篮球比赛投球。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt throws a basketball toward a hoop in the park.

sentences.en: Max thinks a tennis match is too long.
sentences.zh: 马克斯觉得网球比赛太长了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, a young boy with blonde hair and a red jacket sits on a bench and yawns next to a tennis racket.

sentences.en: Then they climb a hill to a lake.
sentences.zh: 然后他们爬上小山，来到一个湖边。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt, Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Max, a young boy with blonde hair and a red jacket climb a green hill with a blue lake at the top.

sentences.en: Max takes off his red jacket to swim.
sentences.zh: 马克斯脱下红色夹克去游泳。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, a young boy with blonde hair and a red jacket takes off his red jacket at the edge of the lake.

sentences.en: Swimming is fun on a hot day.
sentences.zh: 炎热的日子里游泳很有趣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt, Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Max, a young boy with blonde hair and a red jacket swim and splash in the lake on a hot day.

sentences.en: Hana is the fastest and wins the race.
sentences.zh: 哈娜游得最快，赢得了比赛。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt reaches the end of the lake first and raises her arm, Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt and Max, a young boy with blonde hair and a red jacket behind her.
